name: TaskView
description: TaskView is a source-available project and task management platform for teams. It offers task lists, Kanban boards, sprints and time tracking, plus organizations with role-based permissions, SSO, webhooks and issue sync with GitHub, GitLab and Gitea.

notes.text: The default login is publicly known. Sign in right away and set your own login, email and password under Account settings > Login and email.
Without SMTP only the default account can sign in. Add the SMTP_* settings (and ALLOW_PUBLIC_REGISTRATION=false for invite-only) to /opt/taskview_data/.env, then restart taskview.
Behind a hostname or reverse proxy, or after an IP change, update APP_URL and CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS in /opt/taskview_data/.env and restart taskview.
